studio.worker.cli.cli_exit.stderr: hatch: The "chunk" argument must be of type string or an instance of Buffer, TypedArray, or DataView. Received undefined

notes: Chat prompt asks for a 40 line list starting with LIST-<token> (Studio: 25 lines); each client is closed at its first visible reply text. Every case has its own conversation (Studio: own account, and own Product for the worker case). Cases run in parallel in one Stack.

Studio has no WebSocket send: the 'ws' client sends over HTTP (202) and observes over the Studio socket, which is then terminated. Studio worker = `interview` of a Product created through POST /v1/creator/products.

defects.title: hatch chat/assistant --stream crashes on the first Studio event
defects.expected: `hatch assistant <msg> --stream` and `hatch chat <product> <worker> <msg> --stream` print the reply as it arrives (the CLI help says so).
defects.actual: The CLI exits 1 with: hatch: The "chunk" argument must be of type string or an instance of Buffer, TypedArray, or DataView. Received undefined. Studio SSE frames carry no `event:` name, so RunObserver (packages/hatch-cli/src/run.js) takes each as event "message", returns undefined for it, and stdout.write(undefined) throws. The Run itself is unaffected and completes.
defects.repro: hatch assistant "hi" --stream (any Studio worker or the Assistant, plain output, not --json)
